notes.title: Road map 2025
notes.content: [p]Hello, everyone! We see how often you ask about the future direction of our game, so we have prepared a roadmap with plans for the coming months. Please note that we can't give exact release dates for updates, and the roadmap only covers game modes—cars will keep being announced separately.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147333/0a34d7967f2ef86b36a3ed077cc7e6fb04766f52.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147333/7c8fd0f0dd609e51391a00aeda7a854c5a4fa0a7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147333/57deb079684ba60f2047ad3f1e6062a6db3702b4.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147333/004e792a1fab8aa2f48526c66b81d5241879ef65.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Disableable censorship and reactions in chat, names for cars and much more!
notes.content: [p]🚗 Added V:850 Wagon, M:Lancer Evo VI to the showroom[/p][p]👍 You can now set reactions to messages in the chat[/p][p]👁‍🗨 Added visual angles to the dyno when changing the width, tilt angle and offset of the wheels[/p][p]📌 You can now give each car in the garage its own name[/p][p]🎨 When choosing a car in the Car Dealership, you can immediately set the color[/p][p]🔎 After purchasing a car, the player now goes straight to the garage (except for the very first purchase)[/p][p]💎 Added a x2 bonus for the first purchase of Octons[/p][p]📅 Daily rewards are no longer reset at the beginning of the month, and there are now 28 of them left[/p][p]🙊 Added censorship for the chat, it can be disabled in the profile settings[/p][p]⚙️ When there are 10 or more cars in the garage, a filter button appears in the garage[/p][p]💡 Added notifications about new cars[/p][p]🗿 Improved materials for the animated pilot[/p][p]🔧 Render optimization was performed[/p][p]💾 Reduced memory usage[/p][p]⚖️ Lightened models of the animated pilot[/p][p]⚖️ Lightened models of cars: D:Charger 2gen, G:3102, M:W124 500E, M:Orochi, N:350z, C:Impala, F:512 TR, G: M20 POBEDA, :Diablo, V:S60 R[/p]

notes.title: Tournament refinement
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are pleased to announce that an update is being carried out on all platforms today. Below you can see the list of innovations and improvements:

👑 Maximum rank has been reduced to 5
🔱 Rating accumulates to the maximum at the rank. The maximum can be reached for issued starting tickets.
📉 You cannot lower the LST stage after registering in the phase.
🔥 The issued rating for the race is no longer dependent on the rank.
❗The maximum number of points is displayed in the group top.

🚫 Information about the rank has been removed from the group tops.
⚠ The info widget displays the current stage.
👁‍🗨 If the place in the top is -1, it is displayed —
👥 For a player who does not participate in the tournament, only the general top is shown.
👣 If a player does not participate in a tournament, the footer for his place is not displayed. The layout of the footer of his place has been slightly corrected
💻 The window with rewards for the top has been expanded
📌 Information about the current stage of the tournament has been added to the tournament button
💰 Those who had a problem with the rewards for the tournament can now receive them again

notes.title: Update 2.6.0
notes.content:
🏆 Instead of numerous tournaments there will be a single tournament that lasts a week, it is now divided into 6 stages of 24 hours each
🏎 Added new car: F:512 TR 
📰 Added the new top: Stage 2100
🎨 Paint n' Spray was reworked
💡 Changed the conditions for obtaining the last two qualifications in connection with the new tournaments (reduced the required number of getting into the top tournament from 3 to 1 and from 15 to 4)
